g1.why: Williamson is the mostly white school where she changes how she behaves.

g2.label: 2. Switching between two ways of speaking
g2.why: Code-switching is moving between two languages or speech styles by situation.

g4.label: 4. Where the novel is set

g1.label: 1. 'I feel nervous' → she ___
g1.why: Reported speech shifts the present simple back to the past simple.

g2.label: 2. 'I haven't done anything wrong' → he ___
g2.why: The present perfect shifts back to the past perfect in reported speech.

g3.label: 3. 'I will support you' → she ___
g3.why: 'Will' becomes 'would' when the reporting verb is in the past.

g5.label: 5. 'I saw everything' → he ___
g5.why: The past simple shifts back to the past perfect.

g6.label: 6. 'I'm going to speak…' → she ___
g6.why: 'Am going to' becomes 'was going to' after a past reporting verb.

g7.label: 7. 'You must stay calm' → Starr ___
g7.why: 'Must' becomes 'had to' when the obligation is reported.

g8.label: 8. 'We are proud of you' → they ___
g8.why: The present simple of 'be' shifts back to the past: are → were.

g1.label: 1. 'Can you help me…?' → she asked ___
g1.why: Yes/no questions are reported with 'if' or 'whether'.

g2.label: 2. 'Please read chapter five' → the teacher ___
g2.why: 'Told' takes a personal object; a request becomes told + object + to + infinitive.

g3.label: 3. 'I didn't sell drugs because…' → Khalil ___
g3.why: 'Explained' is the reporting verb that fits giving a reason.

g4.label: 4. 'Don't talk to reporters' → warned her ___
g4.why: A negative instruction is reported as 'not to' + infinitive.

g5.label: 5. 'Where were you last night?' → asked where ___
g5.why: Reported questions use statement word order and backshift the tense.

g6.label: 6. 'What happened at the party?' → asked what ___
g6.why: The past simple shifts back to the past perfect in a reported question.

g7.label: 7. 'I will tell the truth' → promised that he ___
g7.why: 'Will' becomes 'would' after a past reporting verb.

g8.label: 8. 'The sun always rises…' → reminded her that the sun always ___
g8.why: A general truth keeps the present simple, with no backshift.
